packageRules.description: NestJS 12 and @nestjs/typeorm 12 ship ESM only (type: module, no require export condition). This backend and its jest runtime are CommonJS, so loading them fails at import time. Hold these majors until the runtime and test setup support ESM.

TypeORM 1.x dropped the sqlite (node-sqlite3) driver in favour of better-sqlite3, so the upgrade needs a driver swap plus code changes against the production database. Hold it until that migration is planned.
TypeScript majors need a coordinated toolchain upgrade: @typescript-eslint supports <6.1 and ts-jest supports <7, so v7 cannot even be installed. Hold majors until the toolchain catches up.
